sourceRefs.locator: ADC Rapport 2054 (revised December 2011), summary; §4.1.1 house 2 and well 12; C. Nooijen §8.2.1, fig. 8.1 and notes 96–97 for find 330, its metal, legends and estimated striking date.

summary.de: Brunnen 12 durchschneidet die Südwand von Haus 2. Seine Hölzer ergeben eine Datierung um 672 ± 7 Jahre.
summary.en: Well 12 cuts the south wall of house 2. Its timbers suggest a date of about 672 ± 7 years.
